changes_made.explanation: Removed WMT'14 En-Fr dataset as it's only briefly mentioned in Appendix and not part of main evaluations. Added Romanian language for WMT'16 En-Ro task. Kept BERT mentions in models since while used in background discussion, the paper focuses on NMT models.
Confirmed BLEU is the only automatic metric used for evaluation. Normalized to uppercase BLEU.
No LLMs are used as judges/evaluators in this paper. The paper focuses on compression methods for NMT models.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper. All evaluations are based on automatic BLEU scores and computational efficiency metrics.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on model compression for neural machine translation using Tensor-Train decomposition. The evaluation is primarily quantitative using BLEU scores and efficiency metrics (parameter counts, inference speed). No qualitative or LLM-based evaluation methods are used. The metadata extraction was generally accurate with minor adjustments needed for datasets and languages.
